findings.location: Proof, step 7.1: claimed bound for (β_k+1)c_{β+e_k} after reindexing the derivative series
findings.evidence: The supplier hypothesis yields (β_k+1)|c_{β+e_k}| ≤ M(β_k+1)r_k^{-1}∏_l r_l^{-β_l}. The displayed right side in step 7.1 equals this bound multiplied by θ, since θ^{|β|+1}∏_l(θr_l)^{-β_l}=θ∏_l r_l^{-β_l}; for 0<θ<1 it is not implied. For m=1, β=0, c_1=M/r with all other coefficients zero, the claimed inequality fails. This step feeds the higher-derivative coefficient assertion used by cor-uniqueness-of-multivariable-power-series-coefficients, which the assigned lemma uses in Proof step 2.2.
